kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
احتضرتن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرْتُنَّ (iḥtaḍartunna) /iħ.ta.dˤar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرْتُنَّ (uḥtuḍirtunna) /uħ.tu.dˤir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
